run_pipeline_instaflow: run the InstaFlowPipeline to generate images from text prompts using rectified flow and Euler discretization
encode_prompt_instaflow: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings for the InstaFlow text encoder with optional negative prompts
prepare_latents_instaflow: prepare random latent tensors scaled by the scheduler noise sigma for the InstaFlow denoising loop
rescale_noise_cfg: rescale noise guidance tensors to fix overexposure using guidance rescale from the Common Diffusion paper
merge_dW_to_unet: merge delta weights into the UNet state dict with an optional alpha scaling factor for weight updates
